_comment: Single source of truth for the portfolio. To add a project, copy an object in 'projects', edit the fields, and commit. 'featured: true' surfaces it in the Highlights section. 'category' drives the filter tabs. That's it — no build step.

profile.headline: I build small, sharp tools that get out of your way.
profile.subhead: Chrome extensions and Windows apps for people who care about their workflow. No bloat, no accounts, no tracking — just focused software that does one thing well.

projects.name: sSummarizer
projects.tagline: AI summaries for any page, video, or thread.
projects.description: One click turns any web page, YouTube video, or Reddit thread into a clean, readable summary — powered by your own AI provider keys, running entirely on your device.
highlights: Bring your own key — OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, OpenRouter
Real-time streaming summaries with interactive follow-up chat

projects.name: sWinShortcuts
projects.description: A lightweight background service that remaps keyboard and mouse input per application. Custom mouse chords, Caps Lock modes, and a numpad launcher grid — with near-zero latency.
highlights: Per-app profiles that switch automatically on the active window
Alt+mouse gestures and right-button chords mapped to any command
Runs silently in the tray on high-performance low-level hooks

projects.name: sTabControl
projects.description: Automate tab positioning, focus transitions, and duplicate prevention. Built for power users who keep a lot of tabs open and want them to behave.

projects.name: sNeatBookmarks
projects.description: A clean popup for managing bookmarks as a tree, with custom themes and fast search. A polished fork built for everyday use.

projects.name: sBookmarkCleaner
projects.description: Automatically detects broken links, redirects, and duplicates so your bookmark collection stays lean and trustworthy.

projects.name: sGestures
projects.description: Simple, lightweight mouse gestures for faster browsing. Customizable actions with a tiny footprint.

projects.name: sUndoClose
projects.description: Bring back accidentally closed tabs and windows with a keyboard shortcut. Never lose an important tab again.
